title: Shortest routes touching a line
notes: For a return visit, keep a route and the fold or string comparison that justified it. K-1 can vary the boundary direction (P6) or choose a start giving a prescribed contact (P7). Grades 2-3 can construct starts (P5), compare equal minima (P6), or restrict allowed contacts (P7). Grades 4-5 can choose shared contacts or all possible starts (P4-5), then restrictions or uniqueness (P6-7). These are different investigations of the same reflection idea; completing every construction is unnecessary.
